title: Tuner
why: To tell you which note you play and whether it is in tune, Fermata listens through the microphone; the sound never leaves this device.
asking: Your browser is asking whether Fermata may use the microphone.

problem.refused: The microphone is blocked for Fermata, so the tuner can't hear you.
problem.refusedHow: To allow it, open this site's settings (beside the address, or your phone's settings for this browser), allow the microphone, then try again.
problem.missing: No microphone was found on this device, so the tuner can't hear you.
problem.missingHow: Connect one, or allow one in the device's settings, then try again.
problem.unsupported: This browser can't use a microphone here, so the tuner can't hear you.
problem.busy: The microphone couldn't start: another app may be using it. Close it, then try again.
problem.failed: The microphone couldn't start. Try again.
problem.hidden: Listening stopped because Fermata was no longer on screen (for example, you switched to another app or tab).
problem.ended: The microphone was disconnected, so listening stopped.

byEar: You can still tune by ear: “Hear” plays each string.
playOne: Play one note and let it ring.
playOneString: Play one string and let it ring.
keep: Leave the string as it is.
cents: 100 cents make one <term>half step</term> (on the guitar, one fret).
playing: Fermata is playing string {{n}} ({{note}}). Listen, then play yours until they sound the same.
